obligations.law_title: Authorizes the city of Mt. Vernon to establish a school speed zone demonstration program

obligations.actor_raw: Operators of photo speed violation monitoring systems
obligations.action_summary: Ensure camera system operators complete training in setting up, testing, and operating the systems.
obligations.quote: Operators of photo speed violation monitoring systems shall have completed training in the procedures for setting up, testing, and operating such systems.
obligations.law_title: Authorizes the city of Mt. Vernon to establish a school speed zone demonstration program

obligations.action_summary: Have each camera operator complete and sign a daily set-up log recording setup details and self-test results.
obligations.quote: Each such operator shall complete and sign a daily set-up log for each such system that such operator operates that (i) states the date and time when, and the location where, the system was set up that day, and (ii) states that such operator successfully performed, and the system passed, the self-tests of such system before producing a recorded image that day.
obligations.law_title: Authorizes the city of Mt. Vernon to establish a school speed zone demonstration program

obligations.action_summary: Retain each daily set-up log until the system is permanently removed from use or related liability cases are finally resolved.
obligations.quote: The city shall retain each such daily log until the later of the date on which the photo speed violation monitoring system to which it applies has been permanently removed from use or the final resolution of all cases involving notices of liability issued based on photographs, microphotographs, videotape or other recorded images produced by such system.
obligations.law_title: Authorizes the city of Mt. Vernon to establish a school speed zone demonstration program

obligations.action_summary: Ensure each photo speed violation monitoring system undergoes an annual independent calibration check with a signed certificate.

obligations.law_title: Authorizes the city of Mt. Vernon to establish a school speed zone demonstration program

obligations.action_summary: Keep each annual calibration certificate on file until related liability cases from that year are finally resolved.
obligations.quote: The city shall keep each such annual certificate of calibration on file until the final resolution of all cases involving a notice of liability issued during such year which were based on photographs, microphotographs, videotape or other recorded images produced by such photo speed violation monitoring system.
obligations.law_title: Authorizes the city of Mt. Vernon to establish a school speed zone demonstration program

obligations.action_summary: Use technology to prevent recorded camera images from identifying drivers, passengers, or vehicle contents to the extent practicable.

obligations.action_summary: Destroy camera-produced images upon final resolution of the related liability notice or one year after issuance, whichever is later.
